mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is the current FEDFUNDS level: lower values predict higher returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings growth and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal activates when UNRATE > 8.0.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 8.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) below 13500 and industrial production (INDPRO) below 98.0 signal economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal activates when both series fall below thresholds.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where GDPC1 < 13500 AND INDPRO < 98.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%) compress equity valuations through higher discount rates, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal activates when FEDFUNDS > 2.0.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 98.0 signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal activates when INDPRO < 98.0.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 98.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) below 750 and retail sales (RSAFS) below 400000 signal weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal activates when both series fall below thresholds.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST < 750 AND RSAFS < 400000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 225 signals elevated inflation, prompting central bank intervention risks and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. The signal activates when CPIAUCSL > 225.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 225, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP (GDPC1) below 13500 signals economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings growth and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. The signal activates when GDPC1 < 13500.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where GDPC1 < 13500, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
